#### Description

AUTOSAR E2E Profile 2 CRC computation fails with TypeError when using Message objects

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-3.2.3.arxml')
msg = db.get_message_by_name('Status')

# This should work but raises TypeError
cantools.autosar.compute_profile2_crc(b'\x00Q"', msg)
```

The error occurs when trying to compute CRC for AUTOSAR E2E Profile 2 messages using a Message object instead of a data_id integer. The function should handle both cases but currently fails with:

```
TypeError: 'NoneType' object cannot be interpreted as an integer
```

This affects the E2E protection functionality for AUTOSAR messages where the message object contains the necessary E2E configuration data.
